cases.description: Kitewell UK revalues its USD balance due to Kitewell US at the September closing rate.
The USD balance due to Kitewell US is remeasured at the September closing rate: a £206.21 change.
One revaluation per monetary balance in a foreign currency; nothing duplicated.
Each revaluation states the balance, the booked and closing amounts and the standard (ASC 830-20).
